app.drop_files: Drop a model folder or a background image / video
models.title: Models
models.subtitle: Pick an avatar or add your own.
models.drop_hint: Or drop a model folder anywhere on the window.
models.browser_hint: Browser preview shows the sample model only. Run the desktop app to add models.
models.expressions_hint: Once: plays and ends by itself (pressing again restarts it). Hold: stays until you press again. Loop: repeats until you press again. Keys can be plain (1, 2, 3) or combinations.
models.zoom_hint: Drag the model to move it, scroll to resize.
tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.subtitle: Your face moves the avatar. Video stays on this computer.
tracking.show_preview_hint: Video: camera image with tracking on top. Tracking only: face outline and hands without your image. Hidden: nothing drawn, saves a little CPU. Tracking works in every mode.
tracking.hands_hint: Draws your hands with every finger on models that support it (Lumi and Kuro do). Uses more CPU/GPU; turn off if FPS drops.
tracking.mirror_hint: The avatar moves like your reflection: you tilt left, it tilts to the screen's left.
tracking.calibration_hint: Look straight at the screen with a relaxed face, then press Calibrate ({hotkey}). Takes 2 seconds.
tracking.expression_calibration_hint: Brows and mouth: follow the prompts for a few seconds so your own range of motion fills the avatar's. Do the relaxed-face calibration first.
tracking.expression_step.brows_up: Raise your brows as high as you can
tracking.expression_step.smile: Smile as wide as you can
tracking.smoothness_hint: Left: follows every small move instantly. Right: calmer motion with a little delay.
tracking.sensitivity.head: Head movement
tracking.sensitivity_hint: Above 1 exaggerates the movement, below 1 calms it down.
tracking.auto_blink_hint: Blinks on its own while your face is not visible.
tracking.breathing_hint: Gentle body movement so the avatar never looks frozen.
mapping.title: Parameter mapping (expert)
mapping.hint: Each row stretches a tracking value range onto a model parameter range.
scene.title: Scene
scene.subtitle: What is behind the avatar, and how the window behaves.
scene.mode_hint.transparent: Window is see-through. In OBS use Window Capture with alpha (macOS).
scene.mode_hint.color: A solid color behind the avatar.
scene.mode_hint.chroma_key: Add a Chroma Key filter in OBS with the same color. Most reliable on Windows.
scene.mode_hint.media: Your own picture or looping video.
scene.no_media: Nothing uploaded yet. PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM and MOV work.
scene.always_on_top_hint: Keeps the avatar window above other windows.
scene.click_through_hint: Clicks go to the windows behind. Turn it off again from the tray icon menu.
scene.obs_hint: To stream: hide the interface, then capture this window in OBS.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, performance and shortcuts.
settings.max_fps_hint: Lower saves battery and CPU; 60 is smooth for streaming.
settings.debug_overlay_hint: Shows FPS, delay, raw face values and lets you pin model parameters.
settings.hotkeys_hint: Click a shortcut and press a new one, for example Ctrl + Shift + H. Esc cancels. Shortcuts work while the app window is active.
settings.storage_hint: Move it with VTUBEAREA_MODELS_DIR or VTUBEAREA_DATA_DIR.
settings.about_text: Works offline and sends nothing anywhere. Still in beta: things change fast, report anything odd.
debug.title: Debug
debug.pin: Pin: set this value by hand
tracking.eye_sync_hint: The camera often sees one eye close less. This closes both together; a clear wink still works.
tracking.resolution_hint: Limited by the camera: the list shows only what it supports (start the camera to see its maximum). Above about 1280 × 720 tracking barely improves, because the models look at a small crop of the face and hands; higher helps mostly when you sit far away.
tracking.frame_rate_hint: More frames mean smoother, faster tracking if your computer keeps up. Only modes your camera supports are listed.
tracking.hand_smoothness_hint: Left follows every finger twitch, right hides jitter at the cost of a little delay.
tracking.arm_stretch_hint: How far stretchy cartoon arms may grow past their drawn length to reach your hand. 0% = never (the hand is pulled back instead), 100% = as the model is made. Models with realistic arms do not stretch.
tracking.elbow_from_wrist_hint: The forearm continues the line of your hand, so tilting the wrist moves the elbow and a hand turned toward the camera shortens the arm. Off: the elbow is guessed from the shoulder and wrist only.
tracking.hand_style_hint: Auto: the model's own painted hand where every finger follows, if it has one, otherwise drawn. Drawn: always drawn, every finger follows yours. Model art: the model's painted hands, including its ready-made poses.
tracking.hands_tips_text: Keep hands fully in the frame and well lit, palms toward the camera. Higher camera resolution helps fingers. Check Debug (Inference, Runs on) if tracking feels slow.
settings.hotkeys_hint_mac: Click a shortcut and press a new one, for example ⌘⇧H. Esc cancels. Shortcuts work while the app window is active.
charts.head: Head rotation
hotkeys.global_on: Global: works even when the app is minimized. Click to make it window-only.
hotkeys.global_off: Window only. Click to make it global (works when the app is minimized).
hotkeys.global_failed: Could not register globally: {message}. Another app may use this combination.
hotkeys.global_hint: Globe on = the hotkey works everywhere, even in a game or OBS, and that key stops reaching other apps. Use it for combos like ⌥1, not plain keys you type with.
expressions.trigger_gesture_hint: While I hold it: the expression stays on as long as you hold the gesture and ends when you let go. On / off: the gesture switches it like its key. A gesture starts one expression at a time; sides are as you see them on the avatar.
expressions.duration_hint: How long the expression stays at full strength before it fades out (Once) or repeats (Loop).
tracking.hand_depth_hint: Estimates how far each hand is from the camera compared to your face. A hand reaching behind your head is drawn under the avatar's head, so the head covers it.
tracking.hand_depth_threshold_hint: How much farther than your face a hand must be. Watch the depth chart below: raise this if hands next to your face hide wrongly, lower it if reaching behind is not detected.
expressions.repeat_count_hint: How many times the loop plays. ∞ = until you press the key again.
items.no_library: Upload a PNG, WebP or GIF (transparent images look best).
items.hint: While this tab is open: drag items on the stage, scroll to resize, Shift + scroll to rotate. Top of the list is drawn on top.
tracking.hand_mirror_hint: On: hands move like your reflection (raise your right hand, the hand on the right of the screen rises). Off: your right hand is the avatar's own right hand. Separate from the face mirror.
gestures.hint: Pull each face to see whether it reads. The bar shows how strongly you show it; the mark is how much is needed. Move the slider left if a gesture is hard to show. Gestures start expressions on the Models tab.
gestures.no_face: Start the camera and look into it to see the gestures read live. You can still set how strongly each must be shown.
gestures.live: How strongly it is shown now
gestures.needed_hint: Left: easier to trigger, but may fire by accident.
gestures.unused: Not tied to an expression yet
gestures.how.wink_left: Close the left eye in the preview and keep the other open.
gestures.how.wink_right: Close the right eye in the preview and keep the other open.
gestures.how.brows_raised: Raise both brows, as if surprised.
gestures.how.brows_lowered: Pull both brows down and frown.
gestures.how.mouth_wide_open: Open your mouth wide, as for “ah”.
gestures.how.big_smile: Smile broadly with the mouth corners up.
gestures.how.head_tilt_left: Tilt your head towards the left shoulder in the preview.
gestures.how.head_tilt_right: Tilt your head towards the right shoulder in the preview.
tracking.eye_closing_lateness_hint: Move right if the avatar shuts its eyes while yours are still a little open; left if it barely closes them.
